# Release Notes: Version 6.7.4
**Release Date:** Nov 25, 2026
---

## 🚀 New Features
 - Feature 1: LOS Checking in Night Scenarios - fixed missing Gunflash counters
 - Feature 2: LOS with complex building overlays
 
---

## 🛠 Bug Fixes
 - Fix 1: Enable clearing of "Moved" flag for GE '42 DB
 - Fix 2: German and Waffen SS FlaK 30 and FlaK 38 limbered sides should show as a normal sized target
 - Fix 3: Ammo Depletion display now turns off
 - Fix 4: HexGrid counter Nudge working
 - Fix 5: LOS bugs with hexside overlay counters (walls, hedges, bocage) fixed
 - Fix 6: CTRL+Numpad Move bug
 - Fix 7: Hatten LOS bugs fixed
 - Fix 8: Disappearing concealed 5/8 counters when rotating fixed
 - Fix 9: Fix text on HW Counters
 - Fix 10: Various bugs causing VASL to crash were fixed
 - Fix 11: Fixed old CH boards that would not open
 - Fix 12: Fix los bug causing los string to be offset on some boards
 - Fix 13: Bridge road LOSH fix
 - Fix 14: Fixed Orchard to Olive Grove transformation on Orchard overlays
 - Fix 15: LOS bug causing crash fixed 
 - Fix 16: Hide the Berserk/Fanatic tags of concealed Japanese units


## Improvements
 - Improvement 1: Preserve Elevation with Overlays hides underlying terrain and persists across sessions
 - Improvement 2: Can now set building type for each hex of mixed building overlays
 - Improvement 3: Allow user configurable opacity for counters during LOS checks
 - Improvement 4: Game Updater function now auto-syncs extensions
 - Improvement 5: Text rendering improvements to various gun and vehicle counters
 - Improvement 6: SVG versions of the bridge/pier counters, Vehicle Dust, Immobilized, stun/STUN +X counters, PFZs, etc
 - Improvement 7: SVG versions of 360 degree pillboxes, barricade and roadblock, drift, and parachute counters
 - Improvement 8: Final set of SVG counter updates. Vehicle and Gun unit depiction updates still need a volunteer artist or artists. Miscellaneous counters can be updated 
   upon request
 - Improvement 9: Consolidated all the BRT-specific counters under a new "Blood Reef: Tarawa" panel in the "HASL and CGs" tab
 - Improvement 10: Add "Broken Ground" draggable overlays and improve "Broken Ground" artwork
 - Improvement 11: Updating various "shared" vehicle counters (bicycles, motorcycles, horses, etc.) to reference the SVG versions of the counters
 - Improvement 12: Ammo Shortage and Low Ammo warnings in Chat
---

## ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
- **Minimum Version Required:** Built with VASSAL 3.8.2

---
